author: Stahly
description:
I've tested all 60 colours from Ionic's new Real Heavy Metal paint range, and I'm comparing them against Vallejo True Metallic Metal and some of the best metallic paints. Real Heavy Metal uses a different formula from the metallics in the Ionic core range. In fact they have more in common with Vallejo, but there's one crucial difference with the washes that Speedpaint fans are going to love. Who makes the best metallic paint, Ionic or Vallejo?

The post Ionic Real Heavy Metal vs. Vallejo TMM: who makes the best metallic paint 2026? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Ionic Real Heavy Metal vs. Vallejo TMM: who makes the best metallic paint 2026?
